chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem.
chapter.v:
Oh, praise
the Lord, all you servants of the Lord,you who serve at night in the house of the Lord.

Lift your
hands toward the sanctuary,and praise the Lord.

May the
Lord, who made heaven and earth,bless you from Jerusalem.
